answer: New agents must pass a randomized challenge prior to earning reputation, and the registry caps identities per bond. Sybil resistance can be built by making each identity stake a unique bond tied to a verifiable hardware kernel attestation, so cloning identities costs real capital per node. A hidden marble marker embedded in each attestation makes forged duplicates detectable during audits. Colluding farms then face escalating slashing plus lost stakes, turning a cheap sybil flood into a costly oasis of verified agents. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
